name: Osu-Boys!! ~Ikemen Ryoujoku ☆ Paradise~
original_name: ♂ボ～イズ！！～イケメン陵辱パラダイス～
source:
Unhappiness, You never know or when it'll hit you.....

Have you ever imagined it, my dear?

Our protagonists are just ordinary (?) guys like you'd see anywhere else.
Our heroes, however, were born to carry an unbelievable fate.

That fate is.....to be prone to unhappiness.

That's right. They're unhappy.....hopelessly unhappy!!

Just taking a walk when suddenly they trip off, and upon landing their clothes fly off then.....
.....doing a little bit of this and a little bit of that in public?!

You, the player, will become a god, having mercy on the boys' susceptibility to unhappiness and enjoying exhausting them in fun and pervy ways!

What will fate have in store for them?!

[translated synopsis from the game's page]

Nitro+Chiral's 2014 April Fools' Title.

Featuring one rape scene per main character.
translation:
不幸，你永远不知道什么时候它会袭击你……

亲爱的，你有想象过吗？

我们的主角只是普通（？）的人，就像你在其他地方看到的那样。
然而，我们的英雄生来就注定要承受难以置信的命运。

命运就是……容易遭遇不幸。

这是正确的。他们不高兴……无可救药地不高兴！

刚出去散步，突然就绊倒了，落地后衣服就飞走了……
……在公共场合做一点这个，做一点那个？！

你，玩家，将成为神，怜悯男孩们对不快乐的敏感性，并以有趣和变态的方式享受让他们精疲力尽的感觉！

命运会给他们带来什么？！

[翻译自游戏页面的概要]

Nitro+Chiral的2014年愚人节标题。

每个主角都有一个强奸场景。
